stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: Each team a dictionary, keys typed by hand

stations.title: Ailsa
stations.note: Every team spelt the same way.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks who leads Bravo, one of tonight's teams.
Today Bravo's keys were typed another way, so the desk shows None led by None.
You write a Team class, give each vehicle its own kit, and turn the rota into teams.
Now Bravo is a team object, and it says who leads it.
Every team keeps its own values, and nothing typed for one turns up in another.
